text:
devon: Hey team — need to add my step-sibling (age 16) to benefits after a custody transfer that finalized yesterday. Is this a qualifying life event? What docs do you need?
ashley-people-ops: Congrats and sorry for the scramble. Yes — a court-ordered custody/guardianship change qualifies as a QLE. We need a legible copy of the court order or guardianship letter, the dependent's DOB, and SSN (if available). Prefer PDFs uploaded to Workday within 30 days of the event.
devon: Court order is digital but the SSN card is with their previous guardian. If I don’t have the SSN within 30 days can I still enroll them provisionally?
ashley-people-ops: You can provisionally enroll if you upload the court order + a government ID (birth certificate or passport) and a notarized guardianship letter. If SSN isn’t available within 30 days, upload the SSN application proof and we’ll mark it pending; final SSN must be provided within 90 days to keep coverage active.
maria-payroll: Quick payroll note: if the dependent is added before the 15th of the month, deductions start the same month; if added after the 15th, deductions start next month. Proration will apply.
devon: Got it. Any carrier-specific forms? Dental/vision usually want something extra?
ashley-people-ops: Usually not for dependents under 26. If a carrier requires EOI or extra forms we’ll request them. For now: 1) Upload court order + ID to Workday Benefits > Documents. 2) Add dependent in Workday > Benefits Enrollments. 3) Reply here with your Workday confirmation number so we can fast-track.
people-ops-bot: Upload link reminder: https://workday.redwood.com/benefits/docs — allowed file types: pdf/png/jpg, max 10MB.
devon: Uploaded the court order and birth certificate, confirmation #WD-4729. I included a note that SSN is pending.
ashley-people-ops: Received WD-4729 — thanks. I’ll submit the carrier enrollment and flag it as provisional pending SSN. Expect carrier confirmation email in 2–3 business days.
maria-payroll: I see the enrollment in the queue. If eligible for retro coverage we’ll calculate proration once carrier confirms the effective date — will update you here.
devon: Appreciate it everyone. One more Q: do I need to provide proof of residency?
ashley-people-ops: If the court order shows custody and address we’re fine. If not, a utility bill or school record in the dependent’s name within the last 90 days works.
devon: Ok added a school enrollment letter to the upload.
ashley-people-ops: Perfect. Follow-up: provisional enrollment accepted; please provide SSN by 2024-10-29 to avoid coverage suspension. If anything changes we’ll ping you here. :thumbsup:
maria-payroll: Noted — I’ll handle deductions once the carrier posts the effective date.
devon: Thank you all :relieved:
